about: Accepted high and critical npm advisories in mobile's shipped dependency tree (npm audit --omit=dev).
Read by infra/scripts/check-npm-audit.py in the mobile CI job. An advisory not listed here fails CI,
and every entry fails CI from its expires date (UTC), so each one is re-reviewed rather than forgotten.
Every fix changes mobile/package-lock.json: 18 of the 20 packages through a lockfile-only npm audit fix,
braces and postcss only with a react-native or Expo SDK major. Mobile ships through App Store binaries and
OTA updates, so that is a mobile change of its own, not part of the CI change that added this file.
Delete an entry when npm stops reporting it.
evidence: 2026-10-03, mobile @ origin/main 5bc57f4, npm 11.6.0: npm audit --omit=dev flagged 75 packages, most only
because they depend on another one; underneath are 71 high or critical advisories in 20 packages (below).
npx expo export --platform ios --platform android --source-maps bundled 146 packages; of the 20 packages
below, only nanoid appears in the source maps. Re-check a reason with that export and the .hbc.map sources.

entries.title: nanoid: non-secure generators can loop indefinitely with negative size
entries.reason: IN the shipped bundle as nanoid/non-secure via @react-navigation (route and navigator keys), but every call site is nanoid() with the default size 21: no size argument and no customAlphabet or customRandom, so the negative, zero and overflowing size paths are unreachable. The overflow advisory is about the secure generator's pool (nanoid/index.js), which is not bundled.
